title: cloud AI: read the console chat's image/PDF file parts as the user and let the agent put that same upload into a record's file field (agent half of #32749, ruled A)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5obaLbqgzRUR9xXfft

Filing gate: ② the cloud half of a maintainer ruling (#32749, ruled A). The console half is PR #34459 (`Part of #32749`); the seat split the card (p1 plan D8): this repo builds the console half, the agent half is cloud code, because the agent service (message parts → model input, tool calls) is not in the framework repo.

Blocked-by: #34459 (the seam lands with it)

## What the console sends (the seam, from PR #34459 "Seam for the agent half")

On `POST /api/v1/ai/agents/:agentName/chat`, in the last `role: 'user'` message's `parts`, one AI SDK v6 file part per uploaded attachment, before the text part, in attach order:

```json
{ "type": "file",
  "mediaType": "image/png | image/jpeg | image/gif | image/webp | application/pdf",
  "filename": "<picked name>",
  "url": "<absolute URL of /api/v1/storage/files/<FILE_ID>>",
  "providerMetadata": { "objectstack": { "fileId": "<sys_file id>" } } }
```

- The `url` is the governed download door, never a data URL: a model provider cannot fetch it. The agent reads the bytes as the requesting user, by `fileId`.
- The stored `sys_file` row: `owner_id` = the user, `scope` user, `status` committed, no owning record. A later record write by the same user naming it in a file field claims it (the existing file-reference lifecycle).
- Caps: 10 MiB per image and per PDF. Files over the cap, of another type, or whose upload failed are not sent; the user text names them as not read. Spreadsheets keep the in-page parse path (no file part).
- `AiMessageSchema.parts` is `z.array(z.unknown())`, so no spec change.

## Acceptance (ruling A, agent half)

1. The agent service turns each such file part into model input as the requesting user: images as image input (bytes read by `fileId` under the user's storage permission), PDFs through the existing `read_file` text extraction. A file the user may not read is refused, not sent.
2. The agent can name such a `fileId` in a file field of a record it creates or edits, through the record's edit door as the user; only files this user uploaded in this conversation are accepted (the agent cannot attach a file id from elsewhere).
3. e2e: one receipt photo in the console chat → a draft claim with the amount filled and the photo on its file field, nothing picked twice.
4. CONTROLs: a spreadsheet attachment still answers through the parse path; a turn with no attachment is unchanged; a `fileId` the user did not upload in this conversation is refused on the attach step.

## Grade note

Filed at p1 with its parent. The maintainer said on 2026-11-16 that the cloud side of in-app building is not urgent (to save CI) while open-source work keeps its priority (#32749 comment 6921550142); whether this half counts as that is for the seat or triage to grade.

## Related

#32749 (ruling A), PR #34459, #30892 (external clients: upload link), #32747 (one link for several files), cloud#797 (spreadsheet attachments precedent).

Dedupe: searched open issues on 2026-11-16 for `chat image attachment agent file field` (7 hits: #32749 and PM seat posts), `AI chat PDF attachment record` (4 hits: #32749 and PM seat posts) and `providerMetadata fileId` (0); none is the agent half of #32749.
